# BuildFlow Enterprise Operations Router

Evercraft public capability ID: buildflow-enterprise-ops-router-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://base44.app/api/apps/6ab26dc00debf9a25bca5f3e/functions/enterpriseOpsAgentRoute

## Use this when

- our business operations are a mess
- we need an ERP but cannot survive a huge implementation
- help an AI understand how our company works
- connect our business systems without replacing everything
- turn spreadsheets and legacy systems into an operating layer
- we need a safer way for AI agents to work with our business
- modernize our operations without a big bang migration

## Problem

A company needs an evidence-native operating layer that can understand existing systems, reconstruct real workflows, surface uncertainty and introduce bounded automation without forcing immediate rip-and-replace.

## Inputs

A non-sensitive problem description for public routing. Private business data is collected only after authenticated tenant handoff.

## Outputs

Ranked smallest-fit BuildFlow capability, safety boundary and human-authentication handoff guidance.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
- Human UI required: yes
- Confirmation: Public routing does not ingest private company records or execute business actions. Authenticated tenant context is required before customer data access.
- Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
